title: Advancing nutrition education: Harvard medical student reflections on a scalable online course
reason: Descriptive course evaluation: module-assessment pass rates, completion time and thematic analysis of written reflections from Harvard medical students. Reflections are analysed qualitatively for themes, not converted to indicators related to success or traits.

extraction.design: descriptive course evaluation plus qualitative thematic analysis

extraction.lms_indicators: module assessment completion; written reflections (activity products, qualitative only)
